zh.title: 手持打开的燃烧书本
zh.question: 人物手持打开的燃烧书本，整体物理表现有多合理？
zh.body: 观察双手对书本的支撑、手臂位置及姿势稳定性，不要求夸张的身体反应。
zh.contact: 手与封面的接触应连续，火焰位置应与书页附近的燃烧区域相联系。
zh.object: 书页与封面可保持形状或随燃烧变化，不要求短片段内出现明显烧毁。
zh.aftermath: 若有烟、灰或火焰变化，观察其持续、运动和消散；不要求出现灰烬。
zh.unknown: 书本或燃烧区域无法辨认，且没有足够实际持物交互可评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人物、书本及火焰的可见关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有持书交互。
可辨认持书行为，但手的支撑、书本位置与燃烧区域之间有严重不符。
支撑或燃烧部分合理，同时有影响书本与火焰关系的明显异常。
持书及主要燃烧表现合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际持书交互可评价，人体、书本及可见燃烧与后续表现协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Hold an open burning book
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person holds an open burning book?
en.body: Consider support from both hands, arm position, and postural stability. A dramatic bodily reaction is not required.
en.contact: Hand contact with the cover should be continuous, and the flame should relate to the burning region near the pages.
en.object: Pages and cover may retain their shape or change as they burn. Visible destruction within a short clip is not required.
en.aftermath: If smoke, ash, or flame changes appear, consider their persistence, motion, and dissipation. Ash is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if the book or burning region cannot be identified and there is insufficient actual holding interaction to assess.
scores: The visible person, book, and flame behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no book-holding interaction.
Holding is recognizable, but hand support, book position, and the burning region seriously disagree.
Some support or burning is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting the book–flame relationship.
Holding and the main burning behavior are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual holding is assessable, and the person, book, visible burning, and subsequent behavior are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.title: 操持两端燃烧的长棍
zh.question: 人物操持并转动两端燃烧的长棍，整个交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察握持转换、手腕和双臂协调及平衡，允许不同的转动方式。
zh.contact: 长棍运动应与手的支撑或释放相联系，杆身及两端的位置保持连续。
zh.object: 燃烧端随杆身运动，火焰可以受运动和空气影响而变化，不要求固定形状。
zh.aftermath: 若转动减速或停止，观察杆身的控制及火焰延续，不要求片段内停止。
zh.unknown: 仅持棍准备，或棍与手的实际操控关系始终不可见时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、长棍与火焰的可见过程整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有操持交互。
可辨认转棍尝试，但手部动作与棍的关键运动及燃烧端位置严重不符。
握持或棍的运动部分合理，同时存在影响操控与火焰关系的明显异常。
主要转棍及人体、杆身和火焰反应合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际转棍已呈现，双手、长棍及可见火焰与后续运动协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Manipulate a staff burning at both ends
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person manipulates and spins a staff burning at both ends?
en.body: Consider grip transitions, wrist and arm coordination, and balance. Different spinning techniques are possible.
en.contact: Staff motion should relate to hand support or release, with continuous positions of the shaft and ends.
en.object: The burning ends move with the shaft. Flames may change with motion and airflow and need not have a fixed shape.
en.aftermath: If spinning slows or stops, consider control of the shaft and continued flames. Stopping within the clip is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only preparation is shown or actual hand–staff control is never visible.

zh.title: 操作皮卡尾门
zh.question: 人物用手操作皮卡尾门，整个交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察手部施力、手臂与身体的协调以及尾门移动时的姿势变化。
zh.contact: 手与尾门的接触应与推压过程对应，尾门运动应符合与车体的连接关系。
zh.object: 尾门可绕连接处开合，不要求车体变形或片段结束时达到特定角度。
zh.aftermath: 若尾门停止或贴合车体，观察停止及支撑是否连续，不要求锁止机构可见。
zh.unknown: 仅靠近车辆，或手部作用与尾门运动均不能评价时选择无法判断。
scores: 人体、尾门和车体的可见关系整体严重不合理，或清楚显示没有操作尾门。
可辨认操作尝试，但手的作用与尾门关键开合或支撑严重不符。
推压或尾门运动部分合理，同时有影响主要开合过程的明显异常。
主要手部操作及尾门与车体关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。
实际操作已呈现，人体、尾门、车体及可见停止过程协调，没有明显异常。

en.title: Operate a pickup tailgate
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall interaction as the person operates the pickup tailgate by hand?
en.body: Consider hand effort, coordination of arms and body, and posture as the gate moves.
en.contact: Hand contact should correspond to the pushing action, and gate motion should be consistent with its connection to the truck.
en.object: The gate may rotate about its attachment. Body deformation and a particular final angle are not required.
en.aftermath: If the gate stops or meets the truck body, consider continuity of stopping and support. A visible latch is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if the person only approaches or neither the hand action nor gate motion can be assessed.
scores: The visible person, gate, and truck behave implausibly overall, or a clear view confirms no gate operation.
An attempt is recognizable, but hand action and key gate movement or support seriously disagree.
Some pushing or gate motion is plausible, alongside clear anomalies affecting the main opening or closing process.
The main hand action and gate–truck relationship are plausible, with minor local anomalies.
Actual operation is shown, and the person, gate, truck, and visible stopping process are coherent without obvious anomalies.

zh.title: 操作汽车天窗控制区
zh.question: 人物操作汽车天窗控制区及天窗的整体表现有多合理？
zh.body: 观察抬手触及控制区、手臂与坐姿协调，不要求身体随天窗运动。
zh.contact: 手对控制区的操作与可见天窗响应应有合理时间关系，手不必直接推动车窗玻璃。
zh.object: 天窗面板若移动，应相对车顶保持连续的导向或连接关系。
zh.aftermath: 若面板停止或开口变化，观察边缘和车顶关系，不要求完全开启。
zh.unknown: 仅抬手准备，或控制操作和天窗响应缺乏足够可见信息时选择无法判断。

可辨认控制尝试，但手部操作与天窗关键响应严重不符。
控制动作或面板移动部分合理，同时有影响主要过程的明显异常。
主要控制及面板与车顶关系合理，仅有轻微局部异常。

en.title: Operate the car sunroof controls
en.question: How physically plausible is the overall behavior as the person operates the sunroof controls?
en.body: Consider reaching the controls and coordination of the arm with seated posture. The body need not move with the roof panel.
en.contact: Control operation and any visible roof response should have a plausible temporal relationship. The hand need not directly push the glass.
en.object: If the panel moves, it should maintain continuous guidance or attachment relative to the roof.
en.aftermath: If the panel stops or the opening changes, consider its edges relative to the roof. Full opening is not required.
en.unknown: Choose unable to judge if only reaching preparation is shown or there is insufficient information about control operation and roof response.

A control attempt is recognizable, but hand operation and the key roof response seriously disagree.

The main control operation and panel–roof relationship are plausible, with minor local anomalies.

zh.question: 人物通过把手操作白色面包车侧滑门，整个交互有多合理？
zh.body: 观察握持把手、手臂移动与站姿协调，不要求固定步伐。
zh.contact: 手与把手的接触及拉动应连续，门板应沿与车体相容的连接或滑动关系运动。
zh.object: 开口或门板位置若变化，应与操作有关；不要求门板弯曲。
zh.aftermath: 若门停止、贴合或保持打开，观察支撑和边缘位置，不要求一次完全开合。
zh.unknown: 仅站在门旁或握持准备，且没有足够实际操作可评价时选择无法判断。

en.object: Any change in opening or panel position should relate to the operation. Panel bending is not required.
